purpose: Reassess persistent breathiness and perceived peaks after level/LF-only processing.

references.title: iZotope: How to remove plosives from a voice recording
supports: Physical air blasts create LF thumps; pop filters/windscreens help prevention at recording.
High-pass filtering can reduce LF energy but can remove voice body and leave distortion.
Target de-plosive or spectral repair at specific offending bands/events and audition.

references.title: iZotope RX Breath Control documentation
supports: Breaths are distinguished from voiced speech by harmonic properties; amplitude alone is insufficient.
Reduce detected breaths selectively; preview detected/removed audio to identify speech damage.
Target-mode treatment can preserve quiet natural breaths.

references.title: Apple: Reduce sibilance in Logic Pro
supports: Sibilance is distinct high-frequency S-type energy.
Use frequency-selective dynamics with chosen frequency, threshold and maximum reduction, guided by analysis and playback.

references.title: iZotope Vocal Editing101 — adjust gain on vocals
supports: Use clip gain to turn down distracting loud individual words/phrases rather than flattening every word to the same level.

local_inferences: Existing03 reductions make the file quieter but cannot alone repair breathy tone, harsh relative transients or recorded intonation.
Software de-plosive processing is the relevant recorded-file treatment; it is not proof of a physical microphone problem in synthesized audio.
Between-phrase breath events may be attenuated; breathiness embedded in voice timbre or unsuitable phrasing can require a cleaner take.
Do not claim clipping or absence of perceived peak problems solely from low current true-peak measurements.
method_decision: Review exact events and source before further processing.
Use no additional blanket gain decrease in the diagnostic, so any improvement tests targeted processing rather than loudness.
Separate gap-breath reduction, residual plosive treatment and high-frequency processing; apply only what evidence supports.
Compare at matched gain and inspect removed signal for vowels/consonants.
No full-episode processing or video render from an unreviewed experimental chain.

After Brody identified the start of disappeared at~2.2s, prioritize smooth local gain reduction on that marked onset. Between-phrase breathiness is a lower priority, so avoid aggressive broad processing.
